name: led-ratio-tool
description: 输入 LED 屏幕物理尺寸，输出真实宽高比、最简整数比与视频画布像素尺寸建议——零依赖纯离线工具
author: LED Ratio Tool Authors

scripts.verify:reproducible: node build.mjs && git diff --quiet dist/led-ratio-tool.html && echo OK: build output matches commit (reproducible) || (echo FAIL: build output differs from commit (not reproducible) && exit 1)
scripts.test: npm run test:redlines && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:noshots
scripts.core:accept: node build.mjs && node --test test/core.test.mjs && node -e "console.log('请确认业务规则变更已获项目负责人批准，然后运行：node -e \"更新 core.lock.json 的 sha256\"')"
